title: Aditya Birla Real Estate aims ₹15,000 crore annual pre-sales in 3 years
description:
Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd is aiming for annual pre-sales of Rs 15,000 crore in the next three years as housing demand continues to be strong across major cities for big branded players, according to a senior company official.
Mumbai-based Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd (ABREL) clocked sales bookings of over Rs 8,000 crore in the past two financial years.
In an interview with PTI, Birla Estates Managing Director (MD) and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) K T Jithendran said, "We are very bullish on demand for residential properties across Mumbai Metropolitan Region, Delhi-NCR, Pune and Bengaluru."
Birla Estates is a subsidiary of ABREL.
Asked about sales bookings guidance for this fiscal, Jithendran said, "We are not giving any short-term targets. In three years' time, which is FY'29, we will have an annual pre-sales of Rs 15,000 crore".
